title: Morning bullet journal - account triage & QBR prep
content:
Morning quick journal — triage list for today (short, reactive, prep for next-week QBRs).

Top priorities (by EOD):
- HelixHealth renewal: lock down decision-maker intro + pricing concession by 2026-03-30.
  - Background: annual renewal coming up (May). They sign if latency < 120ms p50 for embeddings route and support SLA confirmed. Engineering asked for perf logs.
  - Action: pull last 7 days latency breakdown (embed-text v2, region us-east1). Ask SRE for p50/p95 by model. (Jared to pull if I don’t within 90m).
  - Email draft TODO: short proposal + 2 path options (base, premium). Use savings calc template from Confluence.
  - Who to loop: Solutions Eng (Priya) for fallback model variant, Legal for updated T&C if discount applied.

- ScoutMedia support escalation: live job failure on Dedicated batch caching.
  - Incident: recurring OOM when sequence length spikes (CS-3578). Customer reports timeouts during nightly ingest.
  - Immediate fix: enable aggressive KV-trim on model host pool for their tenant; schedule rolling restart off-peak (01:30 local).
  - Notes to self: confirm which Dedicated pool (dp-7b-east) and whether burst capacity is enabled. If not, suggest enabling for 2 weeks to smooth ingest.
  - Customer-facing msg (short): apology + steps taken + ETA for resolution. Keep it under 5 bullets.

- AtlasFin pilot check-in: 30-min sync at 11:00 AM PT. Focus: vector search accuracy drift, embeddings comparators.
  - Prep: bring latest eval for top-50 queries, highlight 4 regressions vs baseline.
  - Ask: do they want automatic rollback if rerank drop > 5%? Note we can set per-route rollback policy.
  - Deliverable: one-pager with recommended rollout (canary 5% -> 20% -> 100%) and rollback thresholds.

Daily running list (tickler):
- [ ] Pull latency/cost per-token for HelixHealth embeddings (last 7 days) — include GPU/quantization flags.
- [ ] Draft renewal options email and attach savings table.
- [ ] Confirm ScoutMedia pool id + schedule restart with infra (SRE ticket).
- [ ] Update AtlasFin one-pager + send pre-read to contacts (Ben & Maya).
- [ ] Review CS health dashboard: top 10 noisy accounts (errors > 0.5% last 24h).

Meeting notes template (use during calls):
- Attendees:
- Outcome desired:
- Action items (owner, due):
- Follow-ups scheduled:

Quick scripts/commands to run (notes to self):
- curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/metrics/latency?model=embed-text-v2&days=7 --output helix-lat.json
- rgrep dp-7b-east /var/logs/serving/* | tail -n 200  # confirm OOM patterns

Draft customer text snippets (copy-paste friendly):
- ScoutMedia (incident update): "Thanks for the heads-up — we’ve enabled a temporary KV-trim profile and scheduled a rolling restart on your Dedicated pool at 01:30 local. We’ll monitor and follow up within 2 hours after restart with logs and next steps. Apologies for the disruption; we’re treating this as high priority."

- HelixHealth (renewal outreach): "Quick note — we’re preparing a renewal proposal tailored to your latency and cost goals. Can we schedule 20 minutes tomorrow to walk options A/B? I’ll bring the performance snapshots and a savings estimate. Suggested times: 10:00 or 15:30 PT."

Unresolved questions / flags:
- For HelixHealth: do they require an on-prem proof-of-concept (was mentioned in last convo) or will Dedicated suffice? (Follow up in call).
- For ScoutMedia: why did sequence-length spikes start on Tuesday? any pre-ingest schema changes? Ask their SRE for recent ingestion logs.

Notes to self (non-actionable items to capture context):
- If offering a one-time discount, use the 10% threshold only if commit >= 12 months and auto-renew enabled. Otherwise finance will push back.
- We should surface fallback model variants in QBR slide deck — simple diagram: primary -> small-quantized fallback -> SLO-based routing. Ask Product to include one slide.

End-of-day wrap (template):
- Done: list (short)
- Blocked: list (who to unblock)
- Next day priorities (top 3)

Random quick reminders (personal):
- Submit monthly expense report (receipts from travel folder).
- Block 1 hour for QBR deck finalization on 2026-04-01.

Timestamp: 2026-03-29 08:04 AM PT — quick save.

DO NOT FORGET: leave clear follow-up items in Jira when creating tickets (owner, severity, due date).
